name: Split PDF by Bookmarks (Chapters)

seo.title: Split PDF by Bookmarks (Chapters) — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Read top-level PDF outline destinations and split the document into chapter PDFs at bookmark boundaries.

assumptions: Only bookmarks that resolve to valid pages are used; unresolved outline items are reported.
limitations: PDF outlines do not always map cleanly to chapter boundaries; nested or out-of-order destinations may need manual review.
